clue.text: Yet someone has to pull the trigger

definitions.text: Yet someone has to pull the trigger

parts.words: Yet someone has to pull the trigger
parts.note: a firearm that fires by itself repeatedly still needs a finger on the trigger, so the clue plays on 'self-acting' versus human action

explanation.surface: A grim remark that, however mechanised warfare becomes, a human still fires the gun.
explanation.walkthrough: The joke is that a weapon called self-acting still needs a person to squeeze the trigger.
explanation.definitionFit: A gun of this kind keeps firing while the trigger is held, yet a person must still press it.

clue.text: Kiss a girl before one is attached

indicators.note: the girl's name is placed before the kiss in the answer

parts.note: Anne is a girl's name
X is the conventional written sign for a kiss

explanation.surface: Someone kisses a girl before becoming attached to her.
explanation.definitionFit: An extension is a building joined on to a main one, something attached to it.

clue.text: Labels for matches

definitions.meaning: a tally can be a tag or label attached to something

explanation.surface: Someone is looking for the labels on boxes of matches.
explanation.definitionFit: Tag-like labels are called tallies, and accounts that agree are said to tally, i.e. correspond.

clue.text: Tricky shot manipulative female has no use for

indicators.note: the female's word lacks the letters that follow, so they are taken out

parts.note: a masseuse is a woman who manipulates muscles
taken as written

explanation.surface: A scheming woman refuses to have anything to do with a clever trick.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Manipulative' suggests scheming, but it means massaging; 'has no' removes USE from MASSEUSE.
explanation.definitionFit: A massé is a billiards stroke made with a steeply raised cue to make the ball swerve, a difficult shot.

clue.text: One drunkard turns up to see another

indicators.note: in a down clue the word is read upwards, so it is turned round

parts.note: a sot is a drunkard
to spot is to see

explanation.surface: One drinker shows up to visit another drinker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Turns up' reads as 'arrives', but in a down answer it turns SOT upside down to TOS.
explanation.definitionFit: A tosspot is a habitual drinker, so it is another drunkard alongside the first.

clue.text: Gold-lined cabinet for a naval officer

indicators.note: the cabinet has the gold set inside it, as a lining

parts.note: a commode is a decorative chest or cabinet
OR is gold in heraldry

explanation.surface: A gilded piece of furniture intended for a sailor of rank.
explanation.definitionFit: A commodore is a naval rank above captain and below rear admiral.

clue.text: Uses the knuckles to fight back

indicators.note: the word for fight is read backwards

parts.note: to spar is to fight, as boxers do

explanation.surface: Someone uses their fists to hit back at an attacker.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fight back' looks like one phrase meaning retaliate; split it, SPAR read 'back'.
explanation.definitionFit: Raps means knocks, striking a door or table with the knuckles.

clue.text: Nice environment

parts.note: Nice capitalised is the French city, so the phrase means the surroundings of that city on the Mediterranean coast

explanation.surface: A pleasant setting.
explanation.walkthrough: The capital N hides the French resort city Nice behind the adjective 'nice'.
explanation.definitionFit: The coastal strip around Nice in southern France is the famous resort coast of that name.

clue.text: Grant, say, a minimal amount to occupant

parts.note: P, a penny, is a minimal amount of money
a resident is an occupant

explanation.surface: Someone awards a tiny sum to the person living in a property.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Grant' looks like a verb; it is Ulysses S. Grant, 18th US president.
explanation.definitionFit: Ulysses S. Grant held the highest office in the US, an example of that office's holder.

clue.text: They should be able to identify any salts in a mixture

definitions.text: They should be able to identify

indicators.note: the letters of the words are mixed up into a new order

explanation.surface: Chemists ought to be able to tell what salts a mixture contains.
explanation.definitionFit: Analysts are experts who examine samples and identify their constituents.

clue.text: Doctor strives to obtain pictures

parts.note: MO is Medical Officer, a doctor
vies means strives or competes

explanation.surface: A doctor works hard to get some images.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Doctor' tempts as an anagram signal for 'strives', but that has seven letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Pictures is an informal word for films, i.e. cinema features.

clue.text: Remove from duty

definitions.meaning: a tax levied on goods, a duty

explanation.surface: Someone is relieved of their job.
explanation.definitionFit: Excise as a verb means cut out, and as a noun it is a tax charged on goods.

clue.text: Describing sounds of one pitch in broadcast

indicators.note: scattered widely, so the letters are strewn into a new order

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Commenting on how a radio transmission sounds all on one note.
explanation.definitionFit: Phonetic means relating to speech sounds and their representation.

clue.text: Big run on a famous Swiss bank

definitions.text: Big run on a famous Swiss bank

parts.words: Big run on a famous Swiss bank
parts.note: reads like a financial panic at a bank, but means a celebrated toboggan course down a snowy slope in St Moritz

explanation.surface: Panicked customers rush to withdraw from a well-known Swiss bank.
explanation.walkthrough: A 'run on a bank' is a financial panic; here 'bank' is a snowy slope and the run is a toboggan course.
explanation.definitionFit: The Cresta Run in St Moritz, Switzerland, is a famous ice toboggan track.

clue.text: Pardon means prison sentence is cut

definitions.meaning: the reduction of a prisoner's term for good behaviour

explanation.surface: A pardon means that a jail term is shortened.
explanation.definitionFit: Remission is both forgiveness of sins and a shortening of a jail term for good conduct.

clue.text: Arrest suspect

definitions.meaning: to seize someone in the name of the law
an old sense of ... is to anticipate fearfully, to suspect

explanation.surface: Police detain a suspect.
explanation.definitionFit: Apprehend means seize by law, and also, archaically, to fear or anticipate something.

clue.text: Deceitful pair confronted

parts.note: a pair is two
faced means confronted

explanation.surface: A dishonest couple were challenged.
explanation.definitionFit: Two-faced describes a hypocrite who shows different faces to different people.

clue.text: It's not becoming a type of fraction

definitions.meaning: a fraction whose numerator is larger than its denominator

explanation.surface: It is unseemly to be just a fraction of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Improper means unseemly, and also names a fraction like 7/4 with top bigger than bottom.

clue.text: Fashion arbiter of Welsh taste

indicators.note: a verb: to fashion is to shape, so the letters are reshaped

explanation.surface: A style arbiter with a Welsh flavour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Fashion arbiter' reads as a style judge; 'Fashion' is the signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Welsh rarebit is a savoury dish of melted cheese on toast, a Welsh treat.

clue.text: Son breaks rules, quits

indicators.note: the son breaks into the word for rules, splitting it

parts.note: reigns means rules as a monarch

explanation.surface: A son disobeys the rules and walks out.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Breaks rules' looks like disobedience; S breaks into REIGNS.
explanation.definitionFit: To resign is to quit a post.

clue.text: Adjust height a fraction

indicators.note: to adjust is to alter, so the letters are altered in order

explanation.surface: Raise or lower something's height slightly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'A fraction' reads as 'slightly' but defines a fraction such as one part in eight.
explanation.definitionFit: An eighth is one of eight equal parts, a fraction.

clue.text: A beggar sorted out contents of bins

indicators.note: the letters are rearranged as if put in order differently

explanation.surface: A beggar rummages through rubbish bins.
explanation.definitionFit: Garbage is household waste, what refuse bins hold.

clue.text: Soft-hearted moneylenders make pretences a reality

indicators.note: the soft letter is put at the heart of the moneylenders' word

parts.note: usurers lend money at high interest
P is piano, soft in music

explanation.surface: Kindly lenders turn people's fantasies into fact.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Soft-hearted' looks like 'kind'; it means P set in the heart of USURERS.
explanation.definitionFit: Those who seize a throne turn a claimed right into actual rule, pretenders who succeed.

clue.text: It holds wine for a service in church

indicators.note: the article and service sit inside the church abbreviation

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
the RAF, Royal Air Force, is one of the armed services

explanation.surface: Communion wine is kept in a vessel for church services.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Service' suggests worship, but it is the RAF.
explanation.definitionFit: A carafe is a glass flask for serving wine or water.

clue.text: Revolutionary firm about belief

indicators.note: the firm's letters go around the revolutionary

parts.note: CO is the abbreviation for company, a firm
a Red is a communist revolutionary

explanation.surface: A radical company concerned with a doctrine.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Revolutionary' tempts as a reversal signal, but it is RED.
explanation.definitionFit: A credo is a statement of belief, a creed.

clue.text: Like whiskey, if rye is used to make it

indicators.note: the letters are put to use to build the word, so they are rearranged

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written

explanation.surface: Whiskey made from rye has a burning quality.
explanation.definitionFit: Strong spirits burn the throat, so whiskey is described as fiery.

clue.text: Tone of voice of doctor in fatigue

indicators.note: the doctor goes inside the word for fatigue

parts.note: to tire is to fatigue
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A doctor's exhausted tone of voice.
explanation.definitionFit: Timbre is the characteristic quality of a sound or voice.

clue.text: New range of French bombs

indicators.note: something new is remade, so the letters take a new order

parts.note: taken as written
des is French for 'of the' (plural)

explanation.surface: A fresh line of French explosives.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenades are small bombs thrown by hand.

clue.text: It makes fast speed at sea

definitions.meaning: fast meaning secure: a tie in rope fixes things firmly
a nautical mile per hour, the unit of speed for ships

explanation.surface: Something that makes a ship go fast at sea.
explanation.definitionFit: A knot ties things firmly, and is also one nautical mile per hour.

clue.text: Scott's craft in exploration

definitions.meaning: Captain Scott's Antarctic expedition ship was named ...
the act of finding out or exploring

explanation.surface: An explorer's ship used on an expedition.
explanation.definitionFit: Robert Falcon Scott sailed to Antarctica on RRS Discovery; discovery also means finding out.
